properties.name: triangulene T1 (triplet, S=1, 2S+1=3)
properties.singlet_triplet_gap_definition: adiabatic electronic energy difference E(S0, restricted closed-shell PM7 minimum) - E(T1, UPM7 minimum), both at their own PM7/Gaussian16 optimized minimum, gas phase, charge 0. ZPE-corrected value 47.3 kcal/mol.
properties.singlet_triplet_gap_reliability: semiempirical (PM7) value; the only singlet accessible under the xtb/pm7 policy is the restricted closed-shell one (Gaussian RPM7; unrestricted UPM7 is blocked by the method policy). GFN2-xTB gives -1.6 kcal/mol for the same restricted comparison, i.e. the two semiempirical Hamiltonians disagree by ~48 kcal/mol, so the magnitude is qualitative. The ordering (triplet ground state) is robust: it follows Ovchinnikov's rule for alternant non-Kekule PAHs and the two-orbital open-shell analysis (open-shell singlet lies ~2K above the triplet).
properties.expected_physical_gap_kcal_mol: small, roughly 1-5 kcal/mol (0.05-0.2 eV), triplet lower - not resolvable at the allowed semiempirical level
properties.geometry: gas-phase PM7 minimum, 34 atoms (C22H12), 0 imaginary frequencies, all C-C 1.39-1.43 A, planar delocalized

properties.name: triangulene S0 (singlet, 2S+1=1)
properties.electronic_state: closed-shell singlet as delivered by the restricted semiempirical wavefunction (RPM7 / restricted GFN2-xTB)
properties.reliability: the exact open-shell (broken-symmetry) singlet cannot be computed at the allowed level (UPM7 rejected by the method policy; GFN2-xTB has no broken-symmetry option), so this node is the restricted closed-shell singlet reference, itself a converged minimum with 0 imaginary frequencies
properties.geometry: gas-phase PM7 minimum, 34 atoms, 0 imaginary frequencies, C-C 1.39-1.44 A (same delocalized framework as T1)

edges.channel: spin recoupling / intersystem crossing (no bond making or breaking)
